Subject: ClearLeaf Azure private offer — MAP, acceptance stages & invoice route

Hi Samir / Maya,

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft and a recommended billing path for the Azure private offer so procurement and finance can align on acceptance and invoicing. High-level notes below and a MAP attachment.

Quick summary:
- Acceptance window: target 10 business days from test kickoff (can extend to 15 if needed)
- Acceptance gates: functional smoke tests -> performance checks on 99th percentile latency -> security checklist signoff (SOC2 evidence already shared)
- Billing route: Azure Private Offer purchase order -> Microsoft processes PO -> Microsoft invoices ClearLeaf -> Redwood recognizes revenue after acceptance milestone (we provide invoice-ready materials)

Reqs / asks for next week:
1) Procurement contact + PO cadence (who will raise the Azure PO internally?)
2) A primary contact for billing (name, email + VAT details)
3) Confirm if acceptance window of 10 business days works for your delivery calendar

I attached: ClearLeaf_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and an outline of the recommended billing flow. Jonas is on the thread for the acceptance test plan and Naomi for invoicing specifics. Karthik will join if any contract redlines are needed.

If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute call with procurement + finance on Monday to walk the steps.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: ClearLeaf Azure private offer — MAP, acceptance stages & invoice route

Samir — great questions. Short answers:

- Azure PO: single PO at subscription level works fine. We do not require vendor-level invoice splitting. Microsoft will issue invoices to ClearLeaf; Redwood will provide the acceptance confirmation and invoice-ready line items once acceptance gate is met.
- VAT/Tax ID: helpful to have before the formal PO so Microsoft can populate invoice correctly, but not blocking for the PO itself.
- Staged acceptance: yes — we can do a two-stage acceptance approach: (A) smoke/functional signoff (3 business days) and (B) perf/regression run (up to 10 business days). MAP draft reflects this option and shows an overall 15-business-day window if you choose staged flow.

Notes for procurement/finance (internal):
- Naomi: once acceptance is confirmed, can you share the invoicing artifact we hand to Microsoft and the suggested line-item labels for ClearLeaf PO?
- Jonas: can you finalize the acceptance test cases and attach the Acceptance_Test_Cases.pdf so the customer's QA team can follow them?

Next steps:
- Samir: send VAT/tax ID and the preferred PO number format
- We will prepare a short DocuSign for the acceptance milestone addendum (no commercial change, just acceptance dates) and share a link by EOD Friday.

Thanks — cc'ing Karthik for legal on redlines.

Best,
Irene
[Attachment: Acceptance_Test_Cases.pdf (doc)]
